import io
import json
import subprocess
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

repo=Path('/workspace/Creative_AI_Project_HUB')
relative='martin-creative-ai-lab-v0.2.0/martin-creative-ai-lab/evaluations/chat-send-buffering/test_runner.py'
path=repo/relative
original_read=Path.read_text
original_exists=Path.exists
def reaped_read(self,*args,**kwargs):
    if str(self).startswith('/proc/'):
        raise ProcessLookupError('controlled reaping during stat read')
    return original_read(self,*args,**kwargs)
def observed_before_reaping(self):
    return True if str(self).startswith('/proc/') else original_exists(self)

results={}
for version, source in (
        ('published',subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'e3bc346:{relative}'],cwd=repo,text=True)),
        ('corrected',path.read_text())):
    module=types.ModuleType(f'cleanup_{version}')
    module.__file__=str(path)
    exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),module.__dict__)
    stream=io.StringIO()
    suite=unittest.TestSuite([module.TaskRunnerTests('test_timeout_stops_inherited_child_even_when_it_ignores_termination')])
    with patch.object(Path,'read_text',reaped_read),patch.object(Path,'exists',observed_before_reaping):
        result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream).run(suite)
    results[version]={'tests':result.testsRun,'failures':len(result.failures),'errors':len(result.errors),'output':stream.getvalue()}
assert results['published']['errors']==1 and 'ProcessLookupError' in results['published']['output']
assert results['corrected']['errors']==results['corrected']['failures']==0
Path('/workspace/work/reaping-probe-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Controlled real-child probe: published assertion errors; corrected assertion passes')
